text.p: British engineering and distribution group Haden Maclellan Holdings Plc said on Wednesday trading across its businesses had started well in 1997 and order books were strong.
"Assuming that international trading and economic conditions remain favourable, the board is confident of the group's ability to maintain its momentum in 1997," Haden Maclellan said in a statement.
Haden Maclellan said it expected further growth in its fasteners business, while industrial services was beginning to benefit from investment in new markets.
Market improvements were expected to help the process engineering business, Haden Maclellan said.
The company reported earlier on Wednesday that pretax profits rose 40 percent last year, while turnover was up 36 percent.
